Owl comes in two forms.

**Owl (desktop app)** is the graphical program for setting up your mods and load order. Install it with `Owl_<version>_x64-setup.exe` on Windows, or the `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage` on Linux.

**Owl CLI** is the same engine as a command-line tool, for scripts and terminals, with no window. Download the file that starts with `CLI_Owl_` for your platform.

The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run.
